summary: Relaxing daily logic puzzles. Slide ice blocks to fill every hole. No timers.
description:
Shut off the outside world.  Relax, unwind and focus with a zen logic game that is simple to learn and compellingly deep.  Puzzle Retreat is a calm, stress relief brain teaser: relaxing logic puzzles that will have you losing track of time. No timers. No leaderboards. It’s just you and the puzzle.

The rules are simple: slide the ice blocks to fill all the holes.  Each block holds a set number of charges and must fill exactly that many holes, so the real challenge is logic, simply work out the correct order to slide the blocks.  This ice block puzzle ramps up with the addition of special blocks including Fire Blocks, Bonsai Trees and Arrows which alter the direction of sliding blocks.  It plays like sudoku and sokoban had a baby: a logic puzzle game you won't find anywhere else.

// FEATURES //
 • Daily Puzzles: three fresh daily logic puzzles every day for free
 • Hints for the ones that bite, unlimited with premium
 • A relaxing puzzle game with no time limits and no stress: the perfect mental break on your commute or while waiting in line
 • Minimalist, soothing design that keeps you focused on the puzzle
 • Stuck on a puzzle? Just move to the next and come back later
 • 60 logic puzzles to solve for free, plus 9 additional packs with over 300 more puzzles available for purchase
 • Works offline: no internet needed, so it’s the perfect offline puzzle game for flights, trains and dead zones
 • Beautifully designed for all devices: tablets and smartphones

Escape to the Puzzle Retreat and unwind with this unique block sliding brain teaser from the creators of the smash-hit Train Conductor series and The Gardens Between.  A few calm minutes of brain training or a long stress relief session. Zen puzzle games don’t get calmer than this. The retreat is always open.
